title: The Silent Intrusion
description: A suspicious process has appeared inside the Aegis research network. Investigate the incident, contain the intrusion and restore system integrity.
briefing: Aegis Command has detected an unexplained process and unusual outbound traffic. You are the on-call systems operator. All actions in this mission take place inside the fictional AegisOS simulation.

objectives.title: Inspect the suspicious process
objectives.description: Open Neural Monitor and inspect the unknown process.

objectives.title: Trace the attack origin
objectives.description: Correlate network events and reconstruct the intrusion path.

objectives.title: Update Aegis Shield
objectives.description: Apply a defensive firewall policy to block the suspicious ingress.

objectives.title: Quarantine the process
objectives.description: Isolate the detected process from the simulated system.

objectives.title: Submit the incident report
objectives.description: Send the final report to Aegis Command.
